title: AI-based Semiconductor Design Automation and Optimization
summary: AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. The figures are first-party aggregate claims.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. The figures are first-party aggregate claims. Partner results are reported in aggregate. The source identifies ASICLAND as a data and deployment partner, but does not allocate every metric to a particular design.
purpose: Automate semiconductor placement and floor-plan optimization.

ratings.reason: The source reports 76% less floor-planning time, from more than a week to roughly a day, across partner deployments. This is a time-saving claim even though it is aggregated.
Higher-value work and professional development for engineers are expected consequences, not measured personal outcomes.

ai_role.statement: Reinforcement learning automates physical chip layout and floor planning. The reported time reductions are attributed to this design workflow, without an independent component comparison.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-based Semiconductor Design Automation and Optimization

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Access to compatible physical-design data such as LEF/DEF files
Integration with the partner's design workflow

headline: AI shortens semiconductor floor planning

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
